selected_script.angle: Aesthetic kitchen gadget review highlighting the zero-mess and steam-perfected results
selected_script.hook: I finally found the kitchen gadget that keeps my microwave totally spotless.

script_record.segment_01: I finally found the kitchen gadget that keeps my microwave totally spotless. No more sauce explosions.
script_record.segment_02: It has this genius little side reservoir. You just add water, and it creates steam while heating to keep your food perfectly moist.
script_record.segment_03: The bottom groove catches all the extra condensation. My meals taste freshly cooked, and my microwave is completely dry and clean!
